transcript.text: vax upright brush thingy stopped spinnin, sucks ok thru the hose but nt pickin up off carpet. smelt like burnin rubber b4 it stopped

⚠ Stop using this appliance
A burning or hot-plastic smell, smoke, scorching or melting can mean an electrical fault or a fire risk. Stop using it, switch it off and unplug it (or turn it off at the fuse box), and don't run it again — not even as a test — until it has been checked by a qualified engineer. Because your Vax upright gave off a burning rubber smell before the brush stopped, please stop using it immediately and unplug it from the mains. That smell usually means the drive belt has snapped or melted due to a jam (like hair wrapped tightly around the roller), or possibly that the brush motor is failing. While I can guide you through safe checks with the power off—such as inspecting the floorhead for blockages or a broken belt—the appliance must not be used again until a qualified engineer has checked it, as there is a potential fire hazard. Please contact Vax support or a local repair service to arrange an inspection.

candidates: Drive belt snapped or melted due to jamming (high)

reading.symptom: brush stopped spinning, not picking up from carpet

plan: Safety: a burning hazard is active. The fixed safety warning is shown separately, do not repeat it. It must not be used again until a qualified engineer has checked it: say that plainly. You may explain the likely cause and suggest checks that are safe with it switched off and unplugged, but never say or imply that a check could make it safe to use, or that they might not need an engineer.
Already given by the customer, never ask for it again: make Vax.
The fault they reported is: "brush stopped spinning, not picking up from carpet". Keep to it: never describe a symptom, result or state they have not told you.

Stage 1 (broad help): say what could cause this, most likely first, as possibilities rather than certainties, including simple causes (settings, loading, detergent, installation, or normal behaviour) where they fit. Then give the one or two safe checks, or the one question, that would best tell those causes apart. Do not ask for the model number in this reply. Do not tell them to buy, order or replace a part yet.
